title: Compass week sync: decision slate and micro-OKRs (v0.1)
body:
Purpose: quick working doc for Compass Week (company-level 2-day alignment). This is a compact decision slate + micro-OKRs draft we can iterate on before the exec rehearsal. Not polished — notes to self and open questions included.

Context and why this matters:
- We are moving from a quarterly cadence to a 6-week tactical rhythm for a set of cross-company priorities (serving runtime stability, Dedicated capacity GTM, Private deploy enterprise pilot). Compass Week is the kickstart: pick final asks, align owners, and publish a short comms deck for the all-hands.
- Outcomes we want by EOD Friday: 1) final decision slate (what we commit to do / defer); 2) 3 micro-OKRs with owners and measurement plan; 3) a 12-slide exec deck + 10 minute all-hands segment (slides populated).

Decision slate (explicit asks we will surface for exec sign-off)
1) Dedicated capacity pricing pilot: commit to 3-month pilot for two anchor customers with discounted reserved slots. Decision: approve pilot pricing floor and list of customers. Owner: Clara Nguyen.
2) Private deployment beta gating criteria: finalize compliance checklist + HSM integration timelines. Decision: yes/no to open beta on Nov 15. Owner: Ravi Patel.
3) Serving runtime latency SLA: default SLO of p99 < 350ms for hosted models below 1024 tokens. Decision: adopt SLO and budget for two additional GPU nodes for redundancy. Owner: Samir Desai.
4) Console rollout: A/B enable rollout for new rollout UX to 10% of teams; decision: approve feature flag and rollback policy. Owner: Leah O'Connor.

Micro-OKRs (drafts — measurable and small)
- Micro-OKR A: Reduce p99 end-to-end latency for small-medium payloads
  - Objective: Improve 95/99 latency for <1024 token requests for top-10 models
  - Key results: p99 down from 420ms -> <=350ms on average across regions (prod); reduce median by 15%
  - Owner: Samir Desai
  - Measures: per-model p99 dashboards (Console route latency), CI perf tests (PR: platform/pulls/1284), weekly perf check-ins

- Micro-OKR B: Secure first 2 private deployment customers for closed beta
  - Objective: Ship private deploy onboarding for regulated pilot customers
  - Key results: 2 signed NDA+SOWs; onboarding checklist completed; two green security audits (KMS integration endpoint)
  - Owner: Ravi Patel
  - Measures: SOW sign date, checklist tick-off, audit report artifacts

- Micro-OKR C: Drive Dedicated capacity revenue momentum (sales-led trial conversions)
  - Objective: Convert 25% of pilot reserved pools to paid reserved contracts in 90 days
  - Key results: 3 customers in pilot, 1 conversion to paid 6-month commit, baseline deck + pricing page live
  - Owner: Clara Nguyen
  - Measures: signed MRR, trial utilization metrics, sales feedback tickets

Run-of-show for Compass Week (2-day compressed)
Day 0 (pre-week)
- Prep (ASAP): Collect product/infra one-pagers from owners (max 2 slides each). Deadline: Wed 9am.
- Draft exec deck by Thu EOD. Design owner: Leah.

Day 1 morning — Exec rehearsal (90 mins)
- 0-10m: framing (CEO) — why 6-week rhythm + stakes
- 10-30m: Decision slate (owners present quick asks)
- 30-60m: Micro-OKR deep-dive (owners present KRs + measurements)
- 60-80m: Open concerns (SRE, Compliance, Sales)
- 80-90m: Finalization and commit callouts

Day 1 afternoon — Cross-team breakout syncs
- 3 parallel breakouts: serving-runtime, product/console, sales & security
- Each breakout produces a 1-page action map (owner, due date, blockers)

Day 2 morning — All-hands (30–40 mins segment)
- Quick narrative (CEO/Head of Product)
- 8–10 slide summary of decision slate, micro-OKRs, what to expect next
- Q&A: curated questions from #all-hands-questions channel

Open questions / To resolve before rehearsal:
- Pricing floor for Dedicated pilot: finance needs input — what is acceptable discount vs. baseline MRR? (Action: Clara to sync with Finance — FIN-req: @Leah set intro)
- Compliance gating for Private: what counts as a passed audit for beta? (Action: Ravi -> security, create a short checklist doc and attach audit metric definitions)
- Latency SLO enforcement: what are acceptable penalty/rollback mechanics if SLO is missed? (Action: Samir to draft SLO policy and rollback budget estimate)

Risk register (short)
- Risk: Overcommitting limited infra resources leading to regressions in other areas
  - Mitigation: hold 10% headroom in cluster capacity; scheduled burn-in window; require infra sign-off on resource moves
- Risk: Sales promise mismatch to pilot customers
  - Mitigation: single-source pricing documentation; sales must attach approved pricing appendix to any SOW
- Risk: All-hands confusion / signal noise
  - Mitigation: publish a 1-page FAQ + short follow-up email summarizing decisions and next steps within 24h

Communications plan (post-rehearsal)
- Internal: short all-hands segment + 24h follow-up email + Confluence update (owner: Leah)
- External (customers/partners): a 1-page partner note for pilot customers only (owner: Clara)
- Sales enablement: one-pager pricing cheat-sheet + playbook snippet (owner: Clara + Solutions Engineering)

Deck checklist (minimal)
- Slide 1: Compass Week headline + 1-sentence why
- Slide 2: Top 3 company-level asks and decisions
- Slides 3–5: Micro-OKRs (one slide per OKR)
- Slides 6–7: Risk & mitigations summary
- Slide 8: Timeline & next 6 weeks cadence
- Slide 9: How to get involved (owners, channels)
- Slide 10: FAQ + slack comms link

Notes to self (messy):
- Keep slides <10 minutes for exec portion. Execs hate long decks.
- Add a short snippet from customer success on who to target for Dedicated pilot (names: ACME, Nimbus?)
- Check PR 1284 perf test outputs and attach screenshot to Samir's slide.
- Leah: please make sure to attach the all-hands scheduled calendar invite with prep notes.

Immediate next steps (today)
- Clara: send pilot pricing options to finance (due: EOD today)
- Ravi: draft compliance gating checklist and send to security (due: tomorrow noon)
- Samir: spin a quick latency dashboard snapshot and link to deck (due: tomorrow 4pm)
- Leah: create draft deck skeleton and share in #exec-briefs (due: tomorrow 6pm)

If you see anything missing or if you're listed as an owner and think the ask is unrealistic, edit directly or drop a note in the top comment (this is a working doc).

-- Ava
(Notes: this doc will be cleaned after rehearsal; keep comments inline and don't copy to Confluence until decisions are final.)
